Name: Seasonal Hats (Fashion Sense)
Author: KaileyStardew
Description:
Adds [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2855]Seasonal Hats[/url] to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url], allowing access from the hand mirror.
Includes all original hats, and adds colourable and prismatic versions.

Made with permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53858471]Beans[/url].
